reviewer: Claude 2, independent; did not author the subject
discipline: Refute, do not confirm. v11 is a repair successor, not a remasurement successor: the world did not move between v10 and v11 — HEAD is still e160bc44, required-now is still 28, corpus v7 is still the current payload subject — and the entire warrant of this subject is that it lands exactly one SHOULD-FIX, G21LJ-V10-SF1, without disturbing anything else. That shape dictated the attack, and it is the inverse of the shape v10 presented. The danger in a remasurement successor is a stale carry-forward; the danger in a repair successor is that the repair is cosmetic — that the charged sentence is rewritten into a form that reads like the remedy while the fact it asserts is still false of the artifact's own bytes, or that the rewrite silently buys its consistency by moving something it was not licensed to move. So the review was run as four attacks. First, custody was re-derived from primary sources and not inherited from any predecessor's verdict: every path-plus-sha256 pair anywhere in the document was recomputed from disk, every recordedInputs entry was recomputed, every cited commit was resolved in git and its subject line read, and the live register was read for the DR-G21 status token, the owner cell, the required-now figure, and the standing of DR-102, DR-114 and DR-133. Second, v10 and v11 were flattened to leaf paths and diffed key-by-key, because in a repair successor the delta IS the claim: anything changed beyond the repair is unlicensed motion, and anything left unchanged that the repair falsifies is a new stale carry-forward of exactly the kind v10 died on. Third, the repaired sentence was not read for shape but executed as an assertion — the field it claims v11 recites was recomputed from corpus v7 on disk and set character-by-character against the four sites in v11 that recite it, and the whole document was swept for any surviving instance of the corpus v1 three-item form. Fourth, the fields the repair did not touch but could have falsified — the obligation partition, the leftover triple, the remainder inventories, the speaker labels — were re-derived from the subject's own bytes as arithmetic rather than read as prose.
decisionRule: ACCEPT only at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. No MUST-FIX and no SHOULD-FIX stand, so the verdict is ACCEPT.

acceptanceStatement: The subject is a minimal, correct repair successor. It lands G21LJ-V10-SF1 substantively rather than cosmetically: the repaired disposition note asserts a content that matches live corpus v7 bytes, all five recitation sites are now consistent, and the stale corpus v1 form survives nowhere. The repair moved nothing it was not licensed to move — every operative measurement field is byte-identical to v10 — and falsified no field it left standing. Custody reproduces completely: 55 inline digests, 58 recorded inputs, four commits, the file 08 pin, the live status token, the live owner cell, the live corpus structure and required-now 28. The leftover posture is accurate and conservative: OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING remains leftover-design, nothing is claimed closed, and every remainder the prompt protects is carried explicitly. No MUST-FIX and no SHOULD-FIX stand.
